data.spiritual_significance: For spiritual seekers, the name Nihlah holds deep significance as the lotus flower is often used as a metaphor for the human soul. In Hindu and Buddhist traditions, the lotus is considered a sacred symbol of enlightenment and detachment. Similarly, in Islamic traditions, the lotus flower represents the idea of spiritual purification and upward growth towards the Divine. The name Nihlah, therefore, serves as a reminder of the inner journey towards self-realization, inner peace, and closeness to God.
